defaultPrompt: Implement this Rust CLI requirement with our existing parser and supported Rust version. Complete applicable checks and fix failures caused by the change.
Add focused tests for this command's stdout, stderr, exit status, and affected file effects. Use only the process or OS boundary the claim needs.
Assess why this Rust command retains memory as input grows. Separate supported ownership findings from hypotheses; do not edit or claim unmeasured savings.
